status: Closed — catalog repair and current Plan 4.0 re-verification proven
area: Evidence / Test Catalog / Plan 4.0 certification integrity
finding: The full-catalog validator is blind to 42 percent of the catalog and reports success anyway. tests/catalog/groups holds 23 shard files using five different schemaId values: atm.testCaseGroup.v1 (12 files, the only value normalizeGroupShard accepts), plus atm.testCatalogGroupShard.v1, atm.testGroupShard.v1, atm.testCatalogShard.v1 and atm.testCatalogGroup.v1 (11 files). normalizeGroupShard returns null for the other four schemaIds with no error, no warning and no diagnostic, so loadTestCaseGroupShards silently returns 12 of 23 shards and 18 of 43 case ids are never validated. Some unreachable shards also store ids in a caseIds string array instead of cases[].caseId, so a shape-unaware scan under-counts them further. Eight schema-invalid case ids are hiding inside the unreachable region, belonging to ATM-GOV-0280, ATM-GOV-0284, ATM-GOV-0285 and ATM-GOV-0306.
expectedBehavior: A full-catalog validation run must observe every shard file on disk. A shard that cannot be normalized must fail closed with an explicit diagnostic naming the file and its schemaId; it must never be silently dropped. Catalog green must mean every declared case id was actually checked.
evidenceOrRepro: node --strip-types -e "import('./packages/core/src/evidence/test-case-catalog.ts').then(m=>console.log(m.loadTestCaseGroupShards(process.cwd()).length))" -> 12, against 23 files present in tests/catalog/groups. reportShardReachability (added by ATM-GOV-0313) enumerates the 11 unreachable shards and the 18 hidden case ids. Before ATM-GOV-0313 the shard test exited 0 while skipping all of them.
impact: This undermines the evidentiary basis of the Plan 4.0 completed boundary rather than merely adding a gap. ATM-GOV-0306 is the load-bearing case: the captain handoff certifies it as done/released with all five closure-required validators fresh, but both of its requiredTestCaseIds live in test_group_plan4_mutation_lineage, which uses atm.testCatalogGroup.v1 and is unreachable. Its closure packet was therefore produced by a validator that never read its shard. The same holds for ATM-GOV-0280, ATM-GOV-0284 and ATM-GOV-0285. Any Plan 3.x/4.0 matrix row whose evidence tuple depends on a full-catalog validator receipt must stay not-complete until this item is closed; a green catalog command is not admissible evidence in the meantime.
containment: ATM-GOV-0313 did not repair the 11 shards, because they are sealed deliverables of other closed cards and the captain handoff forbids amending the delivered 0306 lane in place. Instead 0313 added reportShardReachability in packages/core/src/evidence/test-case-catalog.ts and a frozen known-debt register in tests/cli/plan4-catalog-contract.test.ts. The register pins the exact 11 unreachable groupIds and the total of 18 hidden case ids under set equality, so the blind spot cannot grow: any new shard added with a non-accepted schemaId fails the test immediately, and any repair forces the register to shrink deliberately. The register is shrink-only and entries may not be added without owner approval. 2026-08-27 repair: the reachability half is closed — reportShardReachability now returns 50 of 50 shards reachable with 0 hidden case ids, and the frozen UNREACHABLE_SHARD_REGISTER in tests/cli/plan4-catalog-contract.test.ts has shrunk to empty with EXPECTED_HIDDEN_CASE_ID_TOTAL 0. Exposing those shards left five schema-invalid case ids failing the raw shard schema at HEAD (test_six_editor_sealed_source_parity_0338, test_independent_certificate_fail_closed_dimensions_0341, test_release_closeback_digest_parity_0341, test_plan4_foundation_topology_and_17_anchors_0336, test_real_same_candidate_shadow_0337). Those five are now migrated onto the canonical test_task_atm_gov_<card>_<descriptor>_<digest8> namespace, and each shard carries a legacyAliases lineage row so the sealed requiredTestCaseIds of ATM-GOV-0336, 0337, 0338 and 0341 keep resolving without editing any closed card record. node --strip-types tests/cli/plan4-catalog-contract.test.ts, tests/cli/test-case-catalog-shards.test.ts and tests/cli/plan-3x-4x-validator-profile-coverage.test.ts all pass. 2026-08-29 quickfix (claude-008), shard reachability now fails closed. The namespace and lineage repair had removed every unreachable shard from disk, but the mechanism that hid them was still in place: loadTestCaseGroupShards mapped each file through normalizeGroupShard and dropped every null with a filter, so a shard that could not be loaded left no error, no warning and no diagnostic, exactly as this item's finding describes. The frozen register being empty proved the data was clean today; it proved nothing about the next shard. Three seams. (1) loadTestCaseGroupShards refuses the whole set when any file is unloadable, naming every offender with its file name, its schemaId and the specific reason in one message, so a repair is not discovered one failure at a time. Catalog green now means every declared case id was actually read. (2) normalizeGroupShard actually checks the canonical schemaId. It was documented as accepting exactly one schemaId and in fact checked none, so a shard carrying any other namespace was normalised and silently admitted under a schemaId it does not have; the five-variant condition this item reported could therefore recur without any code noticing. (3) describeShardUnreachability names the conditions once and is consulted by both the loader, which fails closed on them, and reportShardReachability, which gains an unreachableReason field and still never throws: a refusal is not a diagnosis, and the report is the surface that must stay readable when the loader will not run. Verified against the 50 shards on disk: all are canonical and complete, so the stricter contract admits every current shard and changes no current result. Coverage in tests/cli/plan4-catalog-contract.test.ts (ACC-7), written red first against the HEAD sources: a non-canonical schemaId and a shard missing required fields both fail the load with their file names, schemaId and missing fields in the message, while the reachability report still enumerates all three fixture files, reports the reasons, and keeps the hidden case-id counts. tests/cli/test-case-catalog-shards.test.ts and the plan4 suite are unchanged and pass, with three pre-existing unrelated failures (plan4-coverage-semantics, plan4-foundation-topology, plan4-validator-catalog-selection) confirmed identical before and after by running them against the HEAD copy of the source. This quickfix repairs the reachability mechanism only. It does not perform the closure re-verification of ATM-GOV-0280, 0284, 0285 and 0306, does not certify Plan 4.0, and does not alter the NOT COMPLETE verdict. 2026-08-29 follow-on quickfix (claude-008), the two catalog consumers the migration left broken. Migrating the shards onto the canonical namespace and the cases[] shape was only half the change: two consumers still read the retired shapes and had been failing ever since, unnoticed because neither failure was attributed to this item. tests/cli/plan4-validator-catalog-selection.test.ts read shard.caseIds, which the migration removed, so the real-shard half of that suite crashed on undefined before any assertion ran; it now reads cases[].caseId and asserts the shard declares at least one id, so an empty shard fails loudly instead of silently proving nothing. tests/cli/plan4-foundation-topology.test.ts compared the shards against docs/reports/plan-4-foundation-replay.json, whose phaseSuite.requiredCaseIds is the sealed record of ATM-GOV-0336 and still names the pre-migration ids; it now resolves those ids through the shards' legacyAliases lineage before comparing, which is precisely the mechanism this item's repair introduced, so no closed card's evidence is rewritten and no assertion is weakened. Both suites pass, alongside plan4-catalog-contract, test-case-catalog-shards, plan4-quality-gauntlet and plan4-final-certification. One unrelated failure was also present: tests/cli/plan4-coverage-semantics.test.ts failed because packages/core/src/evidence/coverage-semantics.ts declares QUALITY_CERTIFICATE_SCHEMA_ID as atm.qualityCertificate.v1 while schemas/evidence/quality-certificate.schema.json pinned schemaId to atm.coverageCertificate.v1. The certificate-identity defect named above was repaired in the same pass rather than deferred, because its cause turned out to be narrower than its symptom. schemas/evidence/quality-certificate.schema.json carried $id atm.qualityCertificate.v1 while its schemaId const, its required list and every property described the coverage certificate of packages/core/src/evidence/coverage-certificate.ts. One file was serving as the contract of two different certificate types, so it could only ever satisfy one of them: the quality certificate produced by coverage-semantics.ts had no schema at all, and the suite asserting its contract had been failing. The repair separates them. schemas/evidence/coverage-certificate.schema.json now holds the original contract under its own $id, and tests/cli/plan4-coverage-certificate.test.ts validates against it. quality-certificate.schema.json is rewritten as the real quality-certificate contract, matching what createQualityCertificate actually emits: the canonical schemaId, modelRelative required and pinned true, the six-value claimKind enum, coverageRatio bounded to 0..1, the seven-value obligation status enum, and the model/assumption/exclusion shapes, with additionalProperties closed throughout. Nothing that was already valid became invalid: the coverage certificate validates against the same contract it always did, now under its own file. tests/cli/plan4-coverage-semantics.test.ts additionally resolved its closed card's pre-migration case id through legacyAliases, the same lineage mechanism used above, instead of searching the shard for an id the migration retired. Every catalog, plan4 and certificate suite in tests/cli now passes with no failures.
followUp: Closed after fresh re-verification on the repaired catalog. The current run passed plan4-closure-assurance-machine (ATM-GOV-0284), plan4-coverage-universe-compiler (ATM-GOV-0280), plan4-mutation-adapter and plan4-mutation-lineage-equivalence (ATM-GOV-0306), plan4-quality-gauntlet (ATM-GOV-0284), plan4-resumable-probe-scheduler and plan4-validator-catalog-selection (ATM-GOV-0285), plan4-catalog-contract, test-case-catalog-shards, and plan-3x-4x-validator-profile-coverage. plan4-final-certification.test.ts returned proven. Keep the unknown-shard fail-closed and legacy-alias coverage; any future catalog schema migration requires a new certification run rather than reuse of this result.
